snippet.title: Paper Soccer // Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3410520/Paper_Soccer/

Paper Soccer is an online turn-based strategy game. Take turns kicking the ball towards each others goal, but each kick draws a line which cannot be drawn again.

Developed by 
Jumbub
